split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate branch commits; positions 1 and 2 are normative, position 3 is determinative; the append-only history on refs/governance/dec-reservations is a separate owner-pushed event chain and is never equated with branch commits
split_justification.reason: Position 1 must exist before the genesis because the genesis events must carry the import contract marking through the committed tool. Position 2 can only exist after the reservations, because no decision may enter a normative branch commit before its id is reserved; the assigned events afterwards bind to exactly this commit. The determinative position exists so evidence describes the fixed pair of branch commit and governance ref oid.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the full tooling test suite passes
the configuration loader binding check passes
every phase declared for the changed subject has run against the new scope (R5)
a commit that introduces or changes a block manifest is green only when every phase that manifest declares has run against it
split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.

guard_package_affected.reason: B0g changes no file under tools/guard, tools/guardpkg or tools/guardops; the installed guard, its package and its digest stay untouched and no guard activation exists in this block. The owner actions of this block are register ref pushes, not guard actions.
